features: Moves active Scoring Dashboard list and event selection to a dedicated database-filtered view instead of post-processing the legacy scoring HTML
Select Existing Event now queries only events whose event status is neither Completed nor Published and which are not Archived
Saved Rounds now joins bdc_events and shows only rounds belonging to active non-completed, non-published, non-archived events
Completed event round status can no longer make a completed event appear as Draft on the active Scoring Dashboard because the event is excluded at query level
Completed Events remains the controlled entry point for reopening an existing completed scoring workflow for amendment
The proven admin/scoring/core.php scoring engine remains unchanged at known-good blob ea9a05219846458a5be26453a01af386c89c0068
Bachata and Salsa dance selection remains available for new active scoring workflows with Salsa limited to Novice, Intermediate and Advanced
No HTML regex filtering is used for completed-event lifecycle enforcement on the active dashboard
